name: io.github.chrischall/resy-mcp
description: Resy reservation management — search, book, cancel, favorites, and Priority Notify for Claude

environmentVariables.name: RESY_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Your Resy account email. Optional — leave unset to use the fetchproxy browser bridge instead.

environmentVariables.name: RESY_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your Resy account password. Optional — leave unset to use the fetchproxy browser bridge instead.

environmentVariables.name: RESY_AUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Pre-obtained x-resy-auth-token. Overrides email/password and the fetchproxy bridge. Power users / CI only.

environmentVariables.name: RESY_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to disable the fetchproxy fallback (forces RESY_EMAIL+PASSWORD or RESY_AUTH_TOKEN).

environmentVariables.name: RESY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Override the public web-app API key (rarely needed)

environmentVariables.name: RESY_TOKEN_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to disable the on-disk token cache and re-authenticate on every process start. Defaults to enabled.

environmentVariables.name: RESY_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.resy-mcp/token.json.

environmentVariables.name: RESY_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for the signed-in page to make an API call the bridge can read the auth token from. Defaults to 30. Capture resolves on the next matching request, so an idle tab needs a longer window than a busy one.

environmentVariables.name: RESY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port for the fetchproxy bridge. The whole fleet shares 37149 (the Transporter extension dials it), so override only for local development, test isolation, or a hosted bridged registration — this is the variable to name in the registration's bridgePortEnv.
